purpose: Compare whether the Buck-style reduced force/thermal/mode family can add source-traceable process information beyond B6N2 while returning conservative reevaluation requests only; Track B proceeds only if a defensible reduced law is identified.

full_dependency_set: lateral model width, lithosphere/crust thickness profiles, initial extension-zone width and initial narrow weakness assumption
initial temperature profile, surface/basal thermal conditions, conductivity/diffusivity, vertical advection, heat production and thermal expansion
brittle yield law/effective pressure and crust/mantle temperature- and strain-rate-dependent ductile flow laws/composition
depth-integrated lithospheric strength, thermal buoyancy, crustal buoyancy, density contrast and gravity
lower-crust viscosity/flow closure, Moho pressure gradient from crust-thickness gradients, effective flow diffusivity or spatial flow solution, evolving thickness field
imposed extension velocity or strain-rate history, spatial deformation zone, finite strain/time increment and initial geometry
thermal/thickness discretization, boundary conditions, force integration and numerical error/stability behavior
minimum_causally_required_set: temperature-depth state sufficient for ductile strength and thermal buoyancy
crust/lithosphere thickness spatial state sufficient for thinning, buoyancy and Moho pressure gradients
applied extension state/rate and spatial zone geometry
constitutive parameters sufficient for brittle/ductile strength and lower-crust flow
derived integrated force components and combined signed force-change diagnostic
must_initialize_before_run: model-domain geometry and initial thickness fields
initial thermal profile and thermal/material configuration
constitutive law identity and material distribution
flow closure for any claimed core-complex/wide-rift distinction
possibly_reducible: temperature profile to a reduced basis only after force-sign/mode preservation is demonstrated
lower-crust flow PDE to the published effective-diffusivity closure only within its justified domain
integrated force components may remain derived diagnostics rather than independent persisted state
limited cross-section scope only with declared boundary/buffer validity
discrete material family IDs with property bundles, never interpolated IDs
unsafe_to_remove_for_full_buck_mode_clai: lower-crust flow when claiming core-complex mode
track_a_buck_dependencies.criterion: Buck computes net force change after finite extension; increasing required local extension force is assumed to widen the deformation zone, while decreasing force favors localization. This requests model/regime reevaluation only; it does not determine ARCANA topology.
track_a_buck_dependencies.known_model_limitation: Buck reports incomplete coupling between lower-crust flow and thermal calculation.
track_a_buck_dependencies.mechanical_content: REDUCED_FORCE_BALANCE_AND_RHEOLOGY; not mechanics-free, but a full finite-element/Stokes solution is not proven necessary for reevaluation-only scope.

track_b_fault_segment_process.evidence_screen: Forward fault-network models located use stress/local heterogeneity, discrete-element or thermo-mechanical mechanics; slip-to-length models consume slip and do not predict its activation from B6N2 alone.

question_requirements.activation: source-supported nucleation/instability or explicitly authorized initial fault state
question_requirements.deactivation: law for exhaustion, stress redistribution, healing, switching or abandonment
question_requirements.interaction: stress/traction transfer or a validated interaction closure
question_requirements.linkage_candidacy: fault-tip geometry plus interaction/fracture criterion; graph proximity alone is insufficient
question_requirements.localization: evolving spatial activity/deformation and a model criterion
question_requirements.regime_reevaluation: model-defined state, predicate margin/status, uncertainty and detector coverage

forbidden_shortcuts: prescribed future fault geometry/slip/event calendar presented as prediction

common_interface.initialize_process_state: bind model/version, authority, POST_EVENT checkpoint, support, initialized state, parameters, uncertainty and replay identity; fail closed on missing required input
common_interface.consume_B6N2_kinematic_forcing: accept only governed vectors and separately authorized experiment interval; map frame/support explicitly; never relabel geometric mismatch as opening
common_interface.advance_process_state_INTERNAL_DT: temporary isolated candidate advancement with state/rates/error/stability; INTERNAL_DT is not dt2 or persistent interval
common_interface.evaluate_regime_predicates: TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN, signed margin where defined, uncertainty, validity, coverage and bracketability
common_interface.evaluate_interface_reevaluation_predicat: exact covered and uncovered segment IDs or declared aggregate support; junction response not inferred
common_interface.evaluate_topology_reevaluation_predicate: REEVALUATE/NO_REQUEST/UNKNOWN request only; no graph output or application
common_interface.evaluate_support_reevaluation_predicates: VALID/INVALID/UNKNOWN and affected support/dependency buffer; no reassignment
common_interface.report_uncertainty: separate parameter, forcing, model-form, spatial, criterion, event-time, numerical and dependency dimensions
common_interface.report_authority_bounds: exact model/source/temporal/spatial validity, unsupported outputs and stop conditions
common_interface.report_adaptive_dt_indicators: integration error/stability, state rate, predicate proximity/rate, uncertainty, validity and bracket width

common_synthetic_test_case.checkpoint: existing governed POST_EVENT plate-pair 1:3 state; read-only
common_synthetic_test_case.junctions: use exact governed incident junction identities from B6N2 scope; no remapping
common_synthetic_test_case.experiment_window: must be separately defined for a future isolated noncanonical experiment; current design does not authorize positive-duration geological-time advancement
common_synthetic_test_case.track_b_without_source_law: record INSUFFICIENTLY_DEFINED/UNKNOWN; do not execute arbitrary activation

covered/uncovered interface IDs, junction support and all four independent B6N4-R1 blocker rows

local spatial scope and dependency/buffer evidence
variable INTERNAL_DT, numerical stability/error estimator, event bracketing and refinement support: demonstrated or untested
deterministic replay identity or stochastic seed/tie-break policy
wall time, memory and solve counts on same environment/configuration; no arbitrary cutoff
model-form complexity, mechanical equations/fields, software/version/license and synthetic-world transfer limits
prototype_go_no_go: source-supported evolving state not reducible to B6N2 diagnostics
at least one scientifically traceable dynamic regime/validity predicate

explicit covered/uncovered interface and junction mapping
topology/support outputs remain requests and fail conservatively when coverage is unknown
variable-step, event detector, uncertainty and replay testable without WORLD_HISTORY publication
mechanics dependency and computational scope explicit

recommendation_basis.track_a: Buck 1991 supplies a signed state-dependent force-change mode criterion but needs explicit thermal/thickness/strength/flow state and contains reduced force-balance mechanics.
recommendation_basis.track_b: Sources located require stress/fracture/discrete-element mechanics or supplied slip; no defensible reduced law for activation of the existing 71 ARCANA segments was identified.
other_authority_still_required: author synthetic initial-state and parameter authority
